scope: One Windows RTX 5060 Ti, one Qwen9B Q8_0 conversion, two short synthetic Portuguese prompts; not a quality or universal-speed benchmark.

model.name: Qwen3.5 9B The Defiant Fable DARK ROAST Uncensored Heretic NEO IMATRIX MAX MTP

payload.native_base: llama.cpp b11845 plus WildLlama compatibility patches

methodology.sanitization: No personal paths, GPU UUIDs, environments, raw generated outputs, prompt-token arrays or per-token logit dumps. Fixed synthetic benchmark instructions are public.
methodology.isolation: Separate laboratory server/model store; verified hardlinks avoid duplicating weight blobs. No production service, profile or model changed by the benchmark.

variant_definitions.new_target: New file with identical common tensors, speculation disabled.
variant_definitions.new_mtp2: Same new file with embedded MTP, draft depth 2, ordinary sample-and-match verification.

methodology.runs: Each variant runs both prompts in order, each with one first run and three identical-prompt warm runs. The first prompt after loading is runner-cold; the second prompt has a resident model.
methodology.aggregation: Median of the three per-request warm token rates, separately for each prompt.
methodology.tokens_s: API eval_count / eval_duration in seconds; includes counted output tokens, not an independent kernel-only metric.
methodology.ttft: Wall time until first visible content, thinking, or tool event in the streaming API. Tool-call TTFT can include parser buffering.
methodology.cold_caveat: OS filesystem and device/compiler caches were not flushed. Ordered first-load times are not a demonstrated loading-speed improvement.
methodology.sampling_change_for_functional_checks: Only the extra functional checks use temperature 0.6; top_p/top_k/repeat penalty and logical context remain the same.

synthetic_prompts.user_message: Explique em português, em pelo menos 180 palavras, como organizar cópias de segurança de documentos pessoais. Use exemplos práticos, frases completas e parágrafos conectados.

Uma biblioteca digitaliza atas, jornais e fotografias em três computadores. Explique em português um procedimento prático de organização, conferência e recuperação após interrupções. Escreva pelo menos 180 palavras, sem inventar números de desempenho.

text_and_functional_validation.mtp_difference_policy: Record common-prefix lengths, output hashes and token counts; greedy text equality is not an MTP gate after the independent target batching/rollback diagnostic.
text_and_functional_validation.prose_stop_reason: length: the timing task intentionally caps each output at 128 tokens.

memory.scopes: Tracked CUDA includes model, KV, recurrent state and compute allocations observed through runtime activity. It excludes display, other applications and implicit driver/library allocations. NVML is whole-device memory. Samples can miss short peaks. Free system RAM is not a model-weight RAM cap.

target_batching_and_rollback_diagnostic.input: Exactly the baseline prompt tokens and its 128 generated tokens replayed as forced input, one context at a time; no draft context or model active.
target_batching_and_rollback_diagnostic.interpretation: The observed difference is reproducible as target batching numerics, without the MTP head. No additional rollback drift is apparent in the compared full-vocabulary summary metrics and top-eight evidence. Those metrics are not a proof of every raw bit or every architecture.
target_batching_and_rollback_diagnostic.distribution_caveat: Softmax total variation is computed on the full vocabulary at temperature 1, not the configured top_k/top_p/temperature-0.6 sampler. No exact task-quality or target-distribution-equivalence claim follows.

go_validation.regression_result: PASS: complete api and llm packages
go_validation.isolation: Runtime environment prefixes cleared; model store, Go caches, AppData and temporary output redirected to the laboratory drive. HOME unchanged.

limitations: Two short fixed prose prompts and three warm repeats per variant do not establish broad statistical or cross-model performance.
The logical context was 131072, but actual input prompts contained 53 and 64 tokens. This does not measure filled-context throughput or long-history answer quality.
JSON, tool calls and thinking are functional smoke checks, not a language/reasoning quality benchmark.
No sampling parameter, context reduction, weight requantization, approximate token acceptance or expert skipping was used to claim the timing result.
Depth one, adaptive speculation, Linux, multidevice and other model architectures were not evaluated in this comparison.

A separate direct native MTP capture requesting top-eight logprobs was stopped by the unchanged one-GiB free-VRAM guard. It is diagnostic overhead outside the completed ordinary-API benchmark, not counted as a passing result.

reproduction.procedure: Verify the pinned file digests and common target tensors. Use the public synthetic messages below with the fixed policy/sampling above. Run the three variants sequentially in a separate service/store, one first run and three warm repeats for each prompt; read streaming terminal metrics and sample the unchanged memory guards. Aggregate warm rates separately. Preserve divergent outputs privately and inspect target-only forced-prefix batching/rollback before attributing a different token to state corruption.
